claim_scores.rationale: Defines `SavedSig` and `FreshSig` with the same field names but different docstring instructions, so load tests instruction overwrite on a compatible predictor.
`FreshSig` changes field metadata via different `desc` values and a conflicting output `prefix`, so the round-trip tests metadata replacement.
Saves `dspy.Predict(SavedSig)` to a `.json` path, builds `dspy.Predict(FreshSig)`, and loads the saved file into it.
Uses `assert loaded.signature.dump_state() == saved.signature.dump_state()` to prove the loaded signature matches the saved state exactly.
Prints both `saved.signature.dump_state()` and `loaded.signature.dump_state()` so the surviving metadata is visible.
The program relies on `dump_state()`/`load_state()` behavior for instructions plus field `prefix` and `description`, matching the documented serialized surface.
